ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY WASHINGTON, D.C. 20460
June 28, 1971
* 4754
Mr. Charles J. Orlebeke
Deputy Under Secretary
Department of Lousing and
Urban Development
Washington, D.C. 20410
Dear Mr. Orlebeke:
This is in response to your letter of April 9, 1971, transmitting for comment the draft Environmental Impact Statement on Operation Breakthrough.
Operation Broakthrough combines urban and environmental planning and is a step forward in solving the problems of metropolitan housing. We e-close sens specific community and would be happy to make available our program personnel to assist you if you think they can be helpful.
Sincerely/yours
Themas E. Carroll
Assistant Administrator
for Planning and Management
Enclosure
